commits.subject: STATE THE SCRATCH-PATH CAVEAT ON MY OWN 42 CLEAN LINES: all eight modules are outside the root cone
commits.summary:
**The limit on every line this probe prints.** Measured 2026-07-29 by walking import AlgebraicJacobian from the root module: 257 of 274 modules are in the root cone, and all eight of this layer are among the 17 that are not. They are committed, so past the grace period -- lake build AlgebraicJacobian does not elaborate them and no #print axioms line THROUGH THE ROOT can reach them. The 42 clean lines are real, kernel-checked and reproducible by running this file, but they are scratch-path, not certified by the root build.

**Also fixed the control name in the header**, which still said probe_control_leaky from an earlier draft while the actual control is Scheme.fgaPicardRepresentability. A caution section that misnames its own control is the kind of defect this file exists to catch. Rooting the eight modules is one import line in AlgebraicJacobian.lean, outside this task write scope; tracked as I-0600 and disclosed in README.md.
